# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC15 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Branch/head: not a Git repository; checkpoint is file-manifest based.

## Scope

RC15 adds active-file Git status for IDE-style version-control context:

- `Esc v f` / `vcs.file-status` opens a read-only `Git File Status` view for
  the active file.
- `:file-status`, `:filestatus`, `:git-file`, and `:gitfile` open the same view
  from the command line.
- The view shows the absolute path, repository root, repository-relative path,
  index state, worktree state, porcelain entry kind, rename/copy source when
  reported, submodule flags when present, and staged/working diff byte counts.
- The view is observational only and points to `Esc v d` plus the existing
  explicit `:stage PATH` / `:unstage PATH` commands for follow-up.
- Git path display now uses the same safe repository-relative normalization as
  diff/stage operations, covering macOS `/var` versus `/private/var` temp paths.
- README and the real-iPad QA matrix document the active-file Git status route.

This keeps Git key-driven views read-only while reducing iPad keyboard friction
when deciding what to inspect or stage.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is local automated and binary/package proof only.

It does not claim the defining hardware route is accepted. The remaining open
gate is a real iPad Magic Keyboard session in Blink Shell over the intended
mosh/SSH path, with exact Blink version, transport, tmux state, route,
installed `w` binary hash, language-server binary/version if used, and human
feel results recorded in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
